Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IISER Pune recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IISER Pune recruitment is Research Associate-I.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Ph.D in Chemistry, Physics, Material Science, or related areas. Candidates who have submitted their thesis are also eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with possible age relaxation for highly qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 58,000/- per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the IISER Pune located?
faq.answer: IISER Pune is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411008.
